strengths.point: Net profit is growing fast year on year.
Operating margin has widened over the last few years.
Interest cost is trivial next to operating profit.

strengths.point: Sales has compounded at a decent five-year clip.
Profit has compounded at a decent five-year clip.

weaknesses.point: Only part of the reported profit turns into operating cash.
Working capital absorbs a very large slice of the year's sales.
Cash stays locked in the working-capital cycle for a long time.
EV/EBITDA is expensive against the sector median.
Inventory days are on the higher side.
Earnings follow a seasonal cycle rather than a steady line.

threats.point: The stock has a history of very deep drawdowns.
Geopolitical tensions and shipping disruptions are cited as key risks impacting operations.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "See what is happening in the world since the last years. Covid has come. Ukraine war. Okay, then there was the West Asia war. Shipping lines disturbance has become very high." (concall transcript - 2026-08-01)

threats.point: Geopolitical situations and war have impacted freight costs and export dispatches.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "Our freight cost has gone down in this quarter because of this war situation and all" (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

threats.point: Short-term margin pressure may occur due to the time lag in passing on raw material price increases to customers.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "Short-term, yes, maybe a month or so. Because it takes some time to pass on the price increase to the customers. Definitely, it impacts a little bit in the short-term." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

threats.point: Historically weak quarters (Jun, Sep, Dec) are still in the cycle.

swot.verdict: Strengths dominate the evidence (S32/W12/O29/T11), led by 'Capital efficiency is high - the business earns well above a normal cost of capital', with 52 points of weight still sitting on the weakness, opportunity and threat side.
